user.title: Set up Com System
user.description: Create the Com System hub. Receivers are added afterwards.

confirm.title: Add a receiver
confirm.description: Add {name} ({type}) as a Com System receiver? It starts enabled. Choose Ignore to stop it being offered.

abort.already_in_progress: This receiver is already waiting to be added.
abort.not_available: This receiver cannot be added because its type is not available or the Com System hub does not exist.
abort.receivers_are_discovered: Receivers are added from discoveries. Create a script with an object field named notification and it will be offered here.

init.title: Com System options
init.description: Notification history keeps the most recent notifications, up to both limits. Changes apply straight away.

receiver.title: Receiver options
receiver.description: Choose the people this receiver relates to. Its area is the area of its device.

create_channel.name: Create a channel
create_channel.description: Creates a notification channel. Notifications that select it get its defaults for anything they do not set.

name.name: Name
name.description: The channel's name. Names are unique, ignoring case. Mobile apps use it as the Android notification channel.

priority.name: Priority
priority.description: How urgent the notification is. Each receiver type maps it to its own mechanism; types without one drop it.

image.name: Image
image.description: An image: a URL (http(s), a /local/ path or a media source ID), or an image or camera entity.

data.name: Data
data.description: Receiver-specific content, keyed by receiver type, for example {mobile_app: {...}, pushover: {...}}. Each receiver reads only its own block.

update_channel.name: Update a channel
update_channel.description: Renames a channel and replaces its defaults. Defaults that are not given are cleared. Renaming removes the old name from Android devices.

name.name: Name
name.description: A new name. Leave empty to keep the current one.

priority.name: Priority
priority.description: How urgent the notification is. Each receiver type maps it to its own mechanism; types without one drop it.

image.name: Image
image.description: An image: a URL (http(s), a /local/ path or a media source ID), or an image or camera entity.

data.name: Data
data.description: Receiver-specific content, keyed by receiver type, for example {mobile_app: {...}, pushover: {...}}. Each receiver reads only its own block.

delete_channel.name: Delete a channel
delete_channel.description: Deletes a channel. Android devices are told to remove it.
